content: macOS Archive Utility (Finder unzip) propagates the com.apple.quarantine extended attribute to every file it extracts from a downloaded archive, including nested app bundles and executables inside them (e.g. a bundled Chromium.app inside a PyInstaller .app). A quarantined .app with no valid/trusted signature is blocked by Gatekeeper on first launch ('cannot be opened because the developer cannot be verified' / 'is damaged and can't be opened'). Recursively clearing with 'xattr -cr /Applications/App.app' or 'xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine' removes the attribute so Gatekeeper no longer blocks it; CVE-2022-32910 showed quarantine propagation itself can be buggy via crafted zips.
